Weekly Jam

Each week, Scritch features a special prompt — the Weekly Jam! Everyone sees the same challenge, so you can sketch alongside other artists around the world. It’s a fun way to get inspired, push your creativity, and share your work with the community. Ready to jam?
There’s no weekly jam at the moment — check back soon for the next challenge!
